commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=d9e705a2e38f73cc6653b43a6e990e590577e909; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; echo mac_arch=$(uname -m); echo mac_os=$(sw_vers -productVersion); if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ollama_installed=true; ollama --version || true; echo '--- ollama list ---'; ollama list || true; echo '--- end ollama list ---'; else echo ollama_installed=false; fi; if curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/tmp/ollama-version.json 2>/dev/null; then echo ollama_local_api_reachable=true; cat /tmp/ollama-version.json; else echo ollama_local_api_reachable=false; fi; echo '--- listeners 11434 ---'; lsof -nP -iTCP:11434 -sTCP:LISTEN || true; echo '--- end listeners ---'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
